input.summary: Narrow the non-solicit to a mutual, 12-month restriction covering only personnel directly involved in the services.
input.comment: [Playbook] We can accept a non-solicit only if it is mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services and runs no more than 12 months after that involvement ends, so we have replaced the one-sided three-year restriction on all Licensor personnel accordingly. The existing carve-outs for general advertising and voluntary inquiries are retained unchanged.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the end of a person's involvement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who is directly involved in the services provided under this Agreement to leave his or her employment with that party.
